description: Queue a retest that reads a finding's merged linked GitHub pull request to check the fix. If the finding has no merged pull request, it returns state needs_merged_pr: link one with link_finding_pull_request first. Requires explicit user confirmation, spends credits and requires write permission. Available for findings in REPORTED, ACKNOWLEDGED, MITIGATING, OPEN_FOR_RETEST or NEEDS_REVISION status with no retest already queued or running. Acts as the API key creator. Results are recorded in finding retest history.

findingId.description: Raw internal finding ID, useful when chaining from another tool.

identifier.description: Human-readable finding identifier such as "ODI-12". Preferred input.

name: request_finding_retest
title: Request a finding retest
